roster_note: Slender column-and-tank tower. Iconic, cheap, and should be very common — a top-tier identity-per-block asset.
utility_program: a slender vertical structure on a substantial concrete footing
a service ladder with a backing structure the full height
a head assembly appropriate to the tower's function
a small equipment hut at the base
a cable or pipe route from the hut to the head
a fenced compound three blocks clear of the structure
circulation: the ladder reaches a real platform, never open air
damage_constraints: the head assembly is damaged; the structure and ladder remain climbable
derive all damage and occupation only from the immutable clean master
use an authored fracture with a gravity-consistent rubble apron, never a cleared box and never per-block random deletion

required_manual_checks: the silhouette is legible from a long distance
the footing is proportionate to the height
